Snake.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a snake-game object by setting length to 1, storing screen dimensions and block size, placing the initial position at the center of the screen, setting score to 0, and assigning the food position." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> SCREEN_WIDTH </REF>: int or float "Width of the game screen."
        <REF> SCREEN_HEIGHT </REF>: int or float "Height of the game screen."
        <REF> BLOCK_SIZE </REF>: int or float "Size of each block in the game."
        <REF> food_position </REF>: tuple or list "Coordinates of the initial food position."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set self.length to the literal integer 1. RESULT self.length]
            [COMMAND Copy SCREEN_WIDTH into self.SCREEN_WIDTH. RESULT self.SCREEN_WIDTH]
            [COMMAND Copy SCREEN_HEIGHT into self.SCREEN_HEIGHT. RESULT self.SCREEN_HEIGHT]
            [COMMAND Copy BLOCK_SIZE into self.BLOCK_SIZE. RESULT self.BLOCK_SIZE]
            [COMMAND Set self.positions to a list containing one tuple whose x-coordinate is SCREEN_WIDTH divided by 2 and y-coordinate is SCREEN_HEIGHT divided by 2; preserve Python division semantics. RESULT self.positions]
            [COMMAND Set self.score to the literal integer 0. RESULT self.score]
            [COMMAND Assign food_position directly to self.food_position, aliasing the same object. RESULT self.food_position]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Snake.move:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Moves the snake head one block in the given direction with screen wrap-around, consumes food if reached, and either resets the game on self-collision or updates the bounded position history." move]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> direction </REF>: tuple of int "Two-element iterable containing horizontal and vertical movement deltas, normally values of -1, 0, or 1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Get the current head position from self.positions[0] and store it in cur. RESULT cur]
            [COMMAND Unpack direction into x and y. RESULT x_y]
            [COMMAND Compute new_x as (cur[0] + x * self.BLOCK_SIZE) % self.SCREEN_WIDTH. RESULT new_x]
            [COMMAND Compute new_y as (cur[1] + y * self.BLOCK_SIZE) % self.SCREEN_HEIGHT. RESULT new_y]
            [COMMAND Set new to the tuple (new_x, new_y). RESULT new]
            [COMMAND If new equals self.food_position, call self.eat_food(). RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the short-circuit condition len(self.positions) > 2 and new in self.positions[2:] and store the boolean result. RESULT collision_occurred]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: collision_occurred is true]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.reset() to reset the game state. RESULT none]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: collision_occurred is false]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Insert new at index 0 in self.positions. RESULT self.positions]
            [COMMAND If len(self.positions) > self.length, pop the last element from self.positions. RESULT self.positions]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Snake.random_food_position:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Repeatedly assigns a new random grid-aligned food position to self.food_position until that position is not occupied by any snake body segment." random_food_position]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the while-loop condition: check whether self.food_position is in self.positions. RESULT condition_met]
            [COMMAND If condition_met is true, compute new_x = random.randint(0, self.SCREEN_WIDTH // self.BLOCK_SIZE - 1) * self.BLOCK_SIZE and new_y = random.randint(0, self.SCREEN_HEIGHT // self.BLOCK_SIZE - 1) * self.BLOCK_SIZE, noting that random.randint is inclusive of both endpoints. RESULT new_x_new_y]
            [COMMAND Assign self.food_position = (new_x, new_y). RESULT self.food_position]
            [COMMAND Re-evaluate the while-loop condition with the updated self.food_position; if it is still in self.positions, repeat the loop body, otherwise exit the loop. RESULT condition_met]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Snake.reset:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Resets the snake game state to a single centered segment with length 1 and score 0, then places food at a random position." reset]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set the snake length to the constant 1. RESULT self.length]
            [COMMAND Set the snake positions list to contain one tuple whose x-coordinate is SCREEN_WIDTH divided by 2 and whose y-coordinate is SCREEN_HEIGHT divided by 2, placing the segment at the screen center. RESULT self.positions]
            [COMMAND Set the game score to the constant 0. RESULT self.score]
            [COMMAND Call random_food_position() to place a new food item at a random position. RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Snake.eat_food:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Increments the snake's length by 1, increases the score by 100, and relocates the food to a new random position." eat_food]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Increment self.length by 1. RESULT self.length]
            [COMMAND Increase self.score by 100. RESULT self.score]
            [COMMAND Call self.random_food_position() to place the food at a new random position. RESULT self]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
